R1.description: The Controller records a returned verdict through the Workflow's own writers in the managed repository, with the guards each command names, a fail-closed interface probe and the state-identity check; the feedback and state written are what the in-place command writes, and each refusal of D1 has its cause and its test

R2.description: A read-only Codex review runs in the H4e clone on a copy of the bound bundle: dirty-tree admission for read-only runs only, the input manifest, the local-stage prompt, the final message read from its file, the composed header and the after-run unchanged check

R3.description: Every cause of D4 is refused with its own test, and each leaves the managed repository unchanged

R4.description: Every ending of D5, including sandbox_breach, and each recover ending on resume, --abandon and drift, has its code and its test, and the clone is removed on each
